title: Definition of Omega
description: Essential Criteria: Omega(E) must be correctly defined as the number of microscopic states at energy E.

title: Formula for S(n)
description: Essential Criteria: The formula for S(n) must be accurately expressed using the correct combinatorial expression.

title: Stirling's Approximation
description: Important Criteria: The derivation of Stirling's approximation must be shown using an integral approximation.

title: Maximum Entropy Condition
description: Important Criteria: The condition for maximum entropy must be derived and shown to occur at n = N/2.

title: Negative Temperature Condition
description: Essential Criteria: The condition for negative temperature must be correctly stated in relation to energy E.

title: Explanation of Negative Temperature
description: Important Criteria: The explanation for why negative temperature is possible in this system but not in a gas must be clearly articulated.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect interpretations of the conditions for S(n) or negative temperature will result in a deduction.
